items.summary: Authorities closed six metro stations Monday for "security reasons" and imposed traffic restrictions/diversions along 20+ stretches ahead of the Congress march to the Supreme Court. Rahul Gandhi on X: "Youth, all opposition parties, civil society groups, all those who believe in democracy and stand by the Constitution of India, will walk with us." Reuters: police "detained thousands of protesters" over the weekend. EC data: 130M names deleted from rolls (28M dead, 63M relocated, 30M untraceable). CJI declined the Congress meeting request by email, per a Congress source. CJP leaders to meet Delhi Police Monday to demand a protest date under the 24-hour ultimatum.
items.title: Delhi locks down again for Monday march: 6 metro stations closed

items.summary: Split-screen news segment with Hindi 'Breaking News' graphics: CJP will return to the streets, preparations underway for another Jantar Mantar demonstration. CJP leaders to meet police at 10 AM Monday to discuss the protest date; next announcement after that meeting.
items.title: NDTV: CJP to return to streets, 10 AM police meeting Monday
